extraction: CROTO aggregation process: meta-Kanban aggregates team Kanbans. Aggregation rules: (1) Team status = max(individual card status). (2) Blocker = any team blocked. (3) Ready = all dependencies met. Maps to our campaign: Engine team status = building/verifying/applying. Verdict team status = verifying/applying/re-verifying. Miss team status = applying/re-verifying. Meta-Kanban shows: if Engine blocked (OOM), Verdict/Miss idle. Orchestrator sees aggregate, reallocates.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether CROTO aggregation provides Orchestrator campaign-level visibility
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
